# E0710: an integer in a schema has no bounds that fit a Cap'n Proto integer

Cap'n Proto integers are sized: Int8 through Int64, UInt8 through UInt64. An
integer with no finite bounds, or bounds wider than 64 bits, has no Cap'n
Proto type to compile to. The schema is valid; the bound is what the compiled
target needs.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				count: int
			}
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0710]: count in schema 0.0 has no bounds that fit a Cap'n Proto integer
 --> lineage.cue:6:5
  |
6 |                 count: int
  |                 ^^^^^
  |
  = note: count in schema 0.0 is int, an integer with no finite bounds; capnp integers are sized (int32, uint8, >=0 & <=100) (Cap'n Proto rule int-unbounded)
  = help: bound it within 64 bits, such as int32, uint8 or int & >=0 & <=100
```
